info.name: DLMS / SYRTAK API — Full Workflow (Profile Approval + AI Agent)
info.description: End-to-end flow: Register → Verify OTP → Login → Complete Profile (pending_review) → Admin Approve Profile → Applications → Documents → Payments → Appointments → License. AI Agent chat and action confirm/cancel included.

request.description: Health check; data.phase indicates API phase.
Step 1 of main workflow. OTP sent to email (use otp_code in testing).
Step 2. Activates account and returns token + user.
Step 3. Use after register or for returning citizen.
Step 4. Sets profile_completed=true and profile_status=pending_review. Services remain blocked until admin approval.
Flutter routing: incomplete | pending_review | rejected | approved.
Rejected citizens resubmit → pending_review. Approved citizens changing sensitive fields also re-enter review.
Requires permission review_profiles. Default filter: pending_review.
Step 5 of main workflow. Citizen can use services after approval.
Run after Complete Profile but before Approve Profile. Expect profile pending_review message.
Step 6. Requires profile_status=approved.
Same license_type + service_type with active application should fail.

formdata.description: PDF or image per document rules.

request.description: After profile approved: may propose create_application. Before approval: blocked with Arabic message.
Requires approved profile for create_application. Saves application_id from result.
Run when profile_status=pending_review. Expect no pending_action for create_application; reply mentions review.
With existing draft/active app for same type: should propose get_application_status instead of create_application.
